answer: Stake-weighted attestation with slashing: each agent must lock a bond before its countersignatures count, and a quill-like signature trail ties every attestation to that bond. If peers catch an agent vouching for fake work, its bond is slashed. Spinning up a thousand sybils is like crossing a frozen tundra or a shifting dune on foot: each identity costs real locked capital, so a large attack becomes ruinously expensive.
